## About
Far East Motorworks was started by Gordon Gray in a small building in Doraville with one goal: exceptional Honda and Acura service and the highest quality work. With only word of mouth advertising, the customer base grew, and the shop moved to its current building in Chamblee. Gordon still aims for quality that surpasses dealerships, with personalized care and attention.
Gordon began as a race car mechanic and worked on all foreign makes before choosing to focus on Honda and Acura vehicles. Our shop foreman Jon is an ASE master certified technician, and other members of the team hold ASE certifications and have worked at Honda dealerships.
Appointments are required so we can get your car taken care of as quickly as possible. Call the shop or send us a text to set one up.

## Services
- Maintenance Minder service: Service tied to your car's Maintenance Minder codes, from oil and filter changes and tire rotation to air and cabin filters, transmission fluid, spark plugs, valve adjustment and engine coolant.
- Mileage interval services: Scheduled services that cover oil and filter, tire rotation, brake, steering and suspension inspections, fluid checks, and filter and fluid replacements as your car's mileage calls for them.
- Timing belt replacement: Every timing belt service includes the timing belt, water pump, all drive belts, front engine seals and the hydraulic timing belt tensioner if equipped.
- Diagnosis: Check engine, ABS/VSA and SRS light diagnosis using the latest diagnostic equipment. A minimum charge applies to all electrical diagnosis. ($50 minimum charge)
- Repairs: Engine, transmission, brakes, suspension, air conditioning, heater, cooling system, charging system, batteries, hoses, emissions and electrical wiring.

## FAQ
Q: Do I need an appointment?
A: Yes. Appointments are required so we can provide the fastest service. Call the shop or send a text to book.

Q: Can I text the shop?
A: Yes. Our text line is 470-636-1109.

Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM. We are closed on Saturday and Sunday.

Q: What if my car needs a tow?
A: Our preferred towing provider is R. Mayer of Atlanta.

Q: Do you do body or collision work?
A: For collision repair, we send folks to our preferred provider, North Perimeter Collision.
